verdict.rationale: The pack shows no Smithery capability for generating a hosted MCP server from an OpenAPI definition or from custom code without protocol work. The documented build paths assume you already have a working MCP server: publishing one deployed elsewhere by URL, distributing a stdio MCPB bundle, or exposing a running server via Uplink. Those are distribution and proxy features, not conversion or no-plumbing hosting, and the October 2026 shutdown leaves Smithery only as a public, non-proxied registry.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn an existing API definition (OpenAPI) or custom code into a hosted MCP server without writing protocol plumbing
